production_audit.scope: Manual review of verbose assembly whose reassembly reproduced the full gated production objects.
production_audit.new_part_state: Two added 32-bit state stores per complete Part construction; no argument-block aggregate clear. Part sizeof 116->244 bytes. Cache objects begin at +116 and +196; state words at +192 and +240.
production_audit.default_lights_constructor: Generic submit removes 36 stores totalling 140 bytes already reset by fold. The grouped window removes both such constructor blocks once per window (72 stores, 280 bytes); repeated one_chunk does not construct fresh Lights.
production_audit.redundant_source: One post-fold source store removed in generic submit and in the window fold path; this separate 4-byte store is not credited in the controlled fresh-Lights helper.
production_audit.kernel_null: Initial kernel=nullptr survives on admitted position and S8 light paths. N16 admission compiler already sinks nullptr into rejection paths; no admitted N16 redundant null write.
excluded: Frame first allocation/preparation and new palette matrix arithmetic
Actual AVK kernel instructions and their argument loads
Full front-end validation and caller transaction/bridge traversal
AbcEye/abc_part cycle price; their code path is unchanged and covered by production compile/host exact-output variants

definitions.cycles:
Price compiled actor setup and observe target data loads/stores.

The real setup code calls observed AVK return edges. Geometry math, kernel
argument reads, TA submission and real model-ID lookup are excluded. Model
cycles assume perfect D-cache; cold-I means one initially cold 8 KiB I-cache
per complete sequence in this synthetic layout. Line counts are touches and
working sets, never inferred Dreamcast misses or hardware timings.
definitions.true_meshlet_lines: Distinct 32B cached address lines between successive light edges for combined passes, position edges for positions-only; first interval includes entry/first meshlet and final interval is exit. Whole-run footprint is a separate address union.
definitions.finer_kernel_lines: Distinct cached 32B lines per kernel-edge interval, summed; a shared line can be counted twice per meshlet. Prepared skin+n16 steady 37->31 versus true meshlet union25->22.
definitions.traffic: Architectural dynamic memory loads/stores include stack and PC-relative literals, exclude instruction fetch and observed kernel argument reads. These are not data-cache fills or bus transactions.
definitions.limitations: Perfect D-cache, synthetic addresses/layout, warmed prepared palettes, exact observed kernel argument bits; no Flycast or console measurements. Cold-I initially empty8KiB once per complete sequence, not a charge applied repeatedly to every meshlet.

hosted_exact_output.comparison: Direct binary byte comparison of complete framed output; every emitted eight-word vertex/header in order, owner/result state, AVK call order, diagnostic counters and separately tagged cache/bake memory snapshots.
coverage: Actual complete production native_actor_fast.cpp submission and one_chunk loops with production clipping and source lighting.
Rigid8, rigid6/source, lazy skin, s8, s16, normal stride fallback, over32768 index-range guards and unavailable palette workspace.
Fast, constant, exact, probe, probe-decline, singular-normal, headroom and per-vertex-alpha lighting; dynamic UV offsets and native texture scales.
Repeated parts, multiple meshlets, frame-cache eviction, changed part/frame light folds, packet and shared direct windows.
Initial n=0 calls, no-index meshes, all-cone-rejected meshes, cone=2 validation, LOD vertex prefixes and one collapsed meshlet.
Cache and Records-stride redirects within a Part; dirty storage before placement construction of Part and Lights.
Real s8 and s16 kernel partial-return/resume from missing palette directions; bake_prepare calls light setup before position setup.
Reserve/begin rejection, short scratch, packet nonstream capacity failure, streaming flush, direct32767 capacity abort and matched end/abort/result counts.
AVK=2 / N16=2 diagnostic reference destinations and counters; separate NO_CLEAR=0 compatibility pair.
limits: Host scalar adapters replace only SH-4 AVK kernel execution and SQ transport; this is not SH-4 floating-point arithmetic or real game TA capture.
The native UI packet/direct owner is a controlled boundary; header inputs and output ordering are compared with a deterministic synthetic header.
The production compiled Make-derived profile/object identity and SH-4 ABI/cycle/traffic evidence are separate controls.
No game assets, Flycast gameplay, physical-console timing, STRICT gameplay trace or whole-frame timing is claimed.

production_assembly_reproduction.scope:
Emit reviewable production assembly and verify it reproduces the gated objects.

The verbose assembly is useful for checking constructor stores and first-use
branches without mistaking a controlled fixture's register allocation for the
production call site's. Reassembly must reproduce the complete qualified TU
object byte for byte. This also checks the Make knob's invalid-value guard and
that the runtime sources have not changed since the production gate.
